title: PlayFamily
description: A curated group of 3-7 plays that share a pre-snap look but attack different areas or use different mechanics. Families are the fundamental design unit — every play should belong to at least one family.

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'Singleback Trio Disguise Family'.

description.description: 1-2 sentences: what makes this a coherent family, what pre-snap look they share, and what they collectively attack.

formation_id.description: ID of the formation shared by all plays in the family (matches data/formations/ stem).

philosophy.description: Offensive philosophy this family belongs to (e.g. 'west-coast', 'power-run', 'air-raid').

base_play_id.description: The anchor play — the play that defines the family's pre-snap look and sets up the companions.

companion_play_ids.description: IDs of 2-7 companion plays that share the base play's pre-snap look. All must exist in data/plays/.

disguise_score.description: How similar the pre-snap look is across all plays in the family (0=all different, 1=identical look). Computed by compare_plays.

defensive_coverage_matrix.description: Map of defense_id → which play in the family attacks it best.

tags.description: Tags inherited from member plays. Include formation, philosophy, level (any-level, high-school, college, nfl).
